change: Dewy dotted prefix plus/minus use the existing fused array/call template, including ND arrays and GPU arrays.
GLSL and SPIR-V emit unary plus as identity instead of falling through to bitwise complement.
Native float32/float64 loop vectorization supports negation through XOR with a splatted sign bit; the default fast-vectorization gate includes pure negation loops.
validation: Independent C bootstrap followed by 383 focused checks in 13.59s. Includes numeric pointer aliases, broadcast semantics, formatter, shaders and GPU array execution.
coverage: Ordinary/fixed arrays, scalar operands, empty shapes, ND broadcasting, nested dotted operations, custom managed-value negation and observable input/callback order.
Real OpenGL ES and Vulkan execution, plus native/wasm CPU fallback; GPU signed zero and float/integer unary plus.

AVX2 and forced SSE2 native loops, float32/float64, lengths 0 through 19, scalar tails, exact sign-bit changes for zero, infinities, NaN payloads and subnormal values. The IR gate verifies both comprehensions and dotted negation vectorize.
runtime: Five paired native samples of 262144 elements times 64 iterations, including allocation/free. Unary kernel 34.99 to 16.99 ms default, 34.88 to 17.11 ms release; equivalent positive fused kernel 16.60/16.50 to 16.77/16.73 ms; C 19.68 ms.
runtime_baseline: The baseline already implements dotted unary syntax and shader fixes, but lacks native fneg vectorization. This isolates the vectorizer change, not an old-language syntax comparison.
compile: Against the prior committed map compiler, three paired self-builds: CPU 1.5166 to 1.5255 seconds; tour CPU 45.25 to 45.44 ms. Warm filesystems, fresh compiler processes, CPU 2.
limits: Native numeric benchmark only; this does not claim faster WebAssembly or GPU rendering.
The equivalent negated numeric kernel uses exact dyadic inputs. No general float reassociation or fast-math change.
GPU tests use the available local drivers, not every graphics device.
Whole suite is delegated to the branch CI; the immediately preceding map change passed 5483 tests locally and full CI.
